subject.title: feat: add transactional rollback for managed updates

question: Should OpenClaw adopt confirmation-gated package-and-state rollback for managed local-prefix npm Gateway updates now, given that live service-manager recovery and rollback proof is intentionally absent from this PR?
rationale: The patch establishes a new update availability, state-recovery, and inbound-work-admission contract; the acceptable operational and support boundary is a maintainer product decision rather than a mechanical review choice.

options.title: Land after live managed-install proof
options.body: Keep the managed-prefix-only scope and require redacted real service-manager transcripts for a confirmed update and an induced rollback before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial change
options.body: Land only a smaller pre-restart candidate-verification improvement and defer package/state rollback plus probation to a separately approved design.

recommendation.title: Land after live managed-install proof
recommendation.body: Keep the managed-prefix-only scope and require redacted real service-manager transcripts for a confirmed update and an induced rollback before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied PR history identifies this person as the author of the proposed managed-update design and the best available routing candidate.
